product_identity.name: Weddly
product_identity.tagline: Two Hearts, One Seamless Wedding Workspace
product_identity.description: A high-end, romantic-yet-modern wedding planning SaaS platform designed for couples. Combines Indonesian wedding traditions (Akad Nikah, Resepsi, Sangjit, Tea Pai, Pemberkatan) with modern productivity, dual-partner collaboration, IDR currency financial control, 8 dynamic visual themes, and Weddly AI advisor.
product_identity.emotional_archetype: Organic Warmth meets Modern Luxury — gentle blush stone, warm ivory, polished typography, and calm structural precision. Avoids tacky pink glitter or generic clipart.

currency_system.input_helper: Auto-formatting thousands separators with clean number parsing

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Editorial Romantic Serif for headings and milestones paired with highly legible Geometric/Humanist Sans (Plus Jakarta Sans, with native Indonesian/Global aesthetic harmony) for dense data, budgets, and forms.

testing_attributes_convention.rules: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, selectors, metrics, and modals MUST feature a explicit `data-testid` formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire JSON guideline file and apply the default 'ivory_champagne' theme variables as default in src/index.css or root theme provider.
2. Implement a unified `ThemeContext` or CSS variable controller in React that allows couples to switch between all 8 themes instantly, persisting choice in localStorage and backend state.
3. Build the 10-step Setup Wizard cleanly with full responsive design, step progression, back/next validation, and direct skip or autofill capabilities.
4. Ensure all currency inputs and displays adhere to IDR standard (e.g. `Rp 150.000.000`), using clean formatters without rounding errors.
5. Include Indonesian wedding ceremonial types natively (Akad Nikah, Resepsi, Sangjit, Tea Pai, Pemberkatan Gereja, Siraman).
6. Build the Weddly AI chat interface with a working model switcher toggle between 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' and 'Gemini 3 Flash' and rich starter prompt chips.
7. Guarantee mobile responsiveness with the floating bottom navigation bar (`md:hidden`) and a sleek desktop sidebar.
8. Maintain high contrast text readability (never use low-contrast grey on grey, never use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or modals).
9. Add `data-testid` to all interactive and key metric components as specified.
10. Use Sonner for toasts (e.g., 'Draft saved', 'Expense added', 'Theme applied', 'Token activated').
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and delicate glassmorphism backdrop filters (12-24px blur).

You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide React icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Main agent relies on the curated image URLs provided in this file. NEVER use fake placeholder URLs.
